description: Repairs r-sql-13b/params-null-and-unset, join-on-predicate-forms, order-expression-forms and agg-expression-composition: Nz is undefined in four queries. Asks the same four questions with IIf(IsNull(x), 0, x) in place of Nz: a LEFT JOIN ON over JA.a and JB.b, Sum and ORDER BY over GA.v, and a declared Long parameter p (unassigned, Null, Empty) projected as itself, p + 1, IIf(IsNull(p), 7, p), (x = p) and (p Is Null) over CX. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE JA (a LONG, g TEXT(5))
CREATE TABLE JB (b LONG, h TEXT(5))
CREATE TABLE GA (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_GA PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, v LONG)
INSERT INTO GA (id, g, v) VALUES (1, 1, 10)
INSERT INTO GA (id, g, v) VALUES (2, 1, 20)
INSERT INTO GA (id, g, v) VALUES (3, 1, Null)
INSERT INTO GA (id, g, v) VALUES (4, 2, Null)
INSERT INTO GA (id, g, v) VALUES (5, 2, 5)
INSERT INTO GA (id, g, v) VALUES (6, Null, 6)
INSERT INTO GA (id, g, v) VALUES (7, Null, 7)
INSERT INTO GA (id, g, v) VALUES (8, Null, Null)
INSERT INTO GA (id, g, v) VALUES (9, 3, 5)
SELECT JA.a, JB.b FROM JA LEFT JOIN JB ON IIf(IsNull(JA.a), 0, JA.a) = IIf(IsNull(JB.b), 0, JB.b)
SELECT Sum(IIf(IsNull(v), 0, v)) AS s FROM GA
SELECT id FROM GA ORDER BY IIf(IsNull(v), 0, v) DESC, id
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x, p AS v, p + 1 AS w, IIf(IsNull(p), 7, p) AS z, (x = p) AS e, (p Is Null) AS n FROM CX;
